entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So, the chief reduced my quota![n]And he even apologized to me!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: He said he's been concerned for[n]my health... which is actually kinda[n]creepy, now that I think about it.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Anyway, that's not all. He said he's[n]letting me re-open my investigation[n]into what happened to Kayo!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: He told me he wants me to do[n]everything I can to pursue the[n]truth. I think... he was serious.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I wonder what happened to make[n]him change so suddenly...?
He reflected on his actions.
Aren't you happy?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...What, just out of the blue?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Of course I am. It's just...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: The whole thing's too convenient.[n]It seems a little fishy, you know?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I mean, you... asked me for the[n]chief's name the other day, right?
Did I? Can't remember.
Uh, nope.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Why are you giving him such a hard time?[n]Aren't you gonna tell him the[n]other good news?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I know where Kayo is.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: That was part of the chief's apology[n]to me. Apparently he did some[n]investigating on his own.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So, he followed up on my journalist[n]friend's source and... it turns out she[n]really is alive after all.
I'm glad to hear that.
Thank god.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: This is incredible news...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: So? Where is she?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...A mental hospital.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: That explains why she hasn't been[n]able to contact me this whole time.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I really wanna go see her, but[n]to be honest... I'm afraid.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm afraid to know the truth.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Not just about Kayo's current state...[n]but about what happened to her[n]that night too.
That's not like you.[clr 27]
You need to pursue the truth.
I'll go with you.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I know...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Honestly, I shouldn't be afraid to[n]face the truth I've been chasing[n]for so long... but I am.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...I won't let that stop me though.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'll do this...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I know that.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Honestly, I shouldn't be afraid to face[n]the truth I've been chasing for so long...[n]but I am.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...I won't let that stop me though.[n]I'll fulfill my promise, and find out[n]what happened to Kayo.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: That's really considerate of you,[n]but the hospital she's in is[n]far out in the countryside.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: But... thank you. You give me[n]the courage I need to do this.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm... going to go see her. No matter[n]what happens, I need to see this through[n]to the end.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Otherwise I wouldn't be Ichiko Ohya,[n]journalist extraordinaire!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: *chuckle* I'm really glad I talked[n]to you about this. I never would've[n]made my mind up without your help.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You know, you're way more than just some[n]high school kid. You're almost like my[n]guidance counselor.
I can sense Ohya's deep[n]appreciation for me...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, by the way...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Everything with the chief worked[n]out okay, but the higher-ups are[n]still keeping an eye on me.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: So I'll need you to keep the juicy[n]tidbits coming! I can't stop writing[n]about the Phantom Thieves now!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...All right, let's see what[n]you have for me today!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I can't wait for next time!
